plugin_asdk_app_6a7b22d4be108191a7061610.productIntro: CAIRO Medicines 查找在欧盟和美国授权的药物，并返回监管机构发布的标签文本本身，并在每个段落中附有产品、文档、部分、来源 URL 和日期。用户可以按品牌名称或活性成分查找药物，将广泛的部分缩小到他们询问的具体警告，查看标签的版本历史记录，并找到其管辖范围内的官方不良事件报告途径。当一个名称与多个产品匹配时，它会列出候选产品而不是选择一个产品，而对于欧盟和美国以外的市场，它会说明限制而不是替换另一个市场的标签。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7b22d4be108191a7061610.productIntroEn: CAIRO Medicines looks up medicines authorised in the EU and the US and returns the regulator-published label text itself, with the product, document, section, source URL and date attached to every passage.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7b22d4be108191a7061610.longDescription: CAIRO Medicines looks up medicines authorised in the EU and the US and returns the regulator-published label text itself, with the product, document, section, source URL and date attached to every passage. Users can find a medicine by brand name or active ingredient, narrow a broad section to the specific warning they asked about, review the version history of a label, and find the official adverse-event reporting route for their jurisdiction. When a name matches more than one product it lists the candidates instead of choosing one, and for markets outside the EU and US it states the limitation rather than substituting another market's label.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7b22d4be108191a7061610.longDescriptionZh: CAIRO Medicines 查找在欧盟和美国授权的药物，并返回监管机构发布的标签文本本身，并在每个段落中附有产品、文档、部分、来源 URL 和日期。用户可以按品牌名称或活性成分查找药物，将广泛的部分缩小到他们询问的具体警告，查看标签的版本历史记录，并找到其管辖范围内的官方不良事件报告途径。当一个名称与多个产品匹配时，它会列出候选产品而不是选择一个产品，而对于欧盟和美国以外的市场，它会说明限制而不是替换另一个市场的标签。
defaultPrompts: Search the EU medicines catalogue for a product and show its governed product details and available official documents.
Retrieve a healthcare-professional warning from an official medicine label and show the passage with full provenance.
Show the official adverse-event reporting routes for a jurisdiction, including audience, source, and verification status.
defaultPromptsZh: 搜索欧盟药品目录中的产品并显示其受监管产品的详细信息和可用的官方文件。
从官方药品标签中检索医疗保健专业警告，并显示该段落的完整出处。

plugin_asdk_app_69e7b8b1a66c8191a8aa34e6.productIntro: Talents Kids 是发现和培养孩子内在潜力的首要方式。通过将绘画、写作和学校项目等日常物品转化为深入的人才洞察，我们帮助家长和教育工作者准确了解孩子的闪光点。
plugin_asdk_app_69e7b8b1a66c8191a8aa34e6.productIntroEn: Talents Kids is the premiere way to discover and cultivate your child's innate potential. By transforming everyday artifacts—like drawings, writings, and school projects—into deep talent insights, we help parents and educators understand exactly where a child shines.
plugin_asdk_app_69e7b8b1a66c8191a8aa34e6.longDescription:
Talents Kids is the premiere way to discover and cultivate your child's innate potential. By transforming everyday artifacts—like drawings, writings, and school projects—into deep talent insights, we help parents and educators understand exactly where a child shines. 

Our platform doesn't just analyze; it acts, generating personalized educational worksheets and creative coloring pages that turn talent discovery into a daily learning adventure. Whether you are tracking progress through earned achievements or exporting comprehensive talent reports, Talents Kids provides the tools you need to support your child's unique journey from the palm of your hand.
plugin_asdk_app_69e7b8b1a66c8191a8aa34e6.longDescriptionZh:
Talents Kids 是发现和培养孩子内在潜力的首要方式。通过将绘画、写作和学校项目等日常物品转化为深入的人才洞察，我们帮助家长和教育工作者准确了解孩子的闪光点。 

我们的平台不仅仅进行分析；还进行分析。它发挥作用，生成个性化的教育工作表和创意彩页，将人才发现变成日常的学习冒险。无论您是通过取得的成就来跟踪进度，还是导出全面的天赋报告，Talents Kids 都可以提供您所需的工具，让您的孩子在掌上实现独特的旅程。
defaultPrompts: Show my child’s recent analysis history and strongest overall talents.
Show my child’s talent dynamics for the last 3 months.
What talent should we focus on right now, and what should I do this week?

plugin_asdk_app_6a8eaa7ef3c88191802426a0.name: Vocaneo
plugin_asdk_app_6a8eaa7ef3c88191802426a0.productIntro: Vocaneo 将 ChatGPT 与法国职业和培训参考数据连接起来：超过 1,000 份工作资料（任务、技能、薪资、劳动力市场紧张局势、人工智能暴露）、RNCP 文凭和认证，以及超过 135,000 个培训项目以及在法国各地提供培训的机构。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8eaa7ef3c88191802426a0.productIntroEn: Vocaneo connects ChatGPT to the French careers and training reference data: over 1,000 job profiles (missions, skills, salaries, labour-market tension, AI exposure), RNCP diplomas and certifications, and more than 135,000 training programmes with the establishments that deliver them across France.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8eaa7ef3c88191802426a0.longDescription:
Vocaneo connects ChatGPT to the French careers and training reference data: over 1,000 job profiles (missions, skills, salaries, labour-market tension, AI exposure), RNCP diplomas and certifications, and more than 135,000 training programmes with the establishments that deliver them across France.

Ask career questions in plain language: « how do I become a nurse in Lyon? », « I am a developer, which jobs could I move to? », « which jobs are hiring without long studies? ». ChatGPT queries the reference data, cross-references jobs, entry routes, training programmes and providers, and cites the matching public vocaneo.com page for every answer.

The connector is read-only, with no account and no configuration: the data served is the public data of vocaneo.com. It collects nothing and gives no individualised advice — it serves verifiable facts from the French national reference data (ROME 4.0, RNCP), kept continuously up to date.

Vocaneo is a French mission-driven company (SAS, ESUS-accredited) building career guidance tools on open data and psychometric assessment.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8eaa7ef3c88191802426a0.longDescriptionZh:
Vocaneo 将 ChatGPT 与法国职业和培训参考数据连接起来：超过 1,000 份工作资料（任务、技能、薪资、劳动力市场紧张局势、人工智能暴露）、RNCP 文凭和认证，以及超过 135,000 个培训项目以及在法国各地提供培训的机构。

用通俗易懂的语言询问职业问题：«我如何成为里昂的一名护士？ », « 我是一名开发人员，我可以跳槽到哪些工作？ », « 哪些工作正在招聘无需长期学习的人？ »。 ChatGPT 查询参考数据、交叉引用工作、进入路线、培训计划和提供商，并为每个答案引用匹配的公共 vocaneo.com 页面。

连接器是只读的，没有帐户，也没有配置：提供的数据是vocaneo.com的公共数据。它不收集任何信息，也不提供个性化建议 - 它提供来自法国国家参考数据（ROME 4.0，RNCP）的可验证事实，并不断更新。

Vocaneo 是一家法国使命驱动型公司（SAS、ESUS 认证），致力于构建开放数据和心理测量评估的职业指导工具。

plugin_asdk_app_6a22ca6ec2608191bc47a4bb.productIntro: UrbanPro Tutor Finder 可帮助学习者找到经验丰富的导师和辅导提供者，涉及学术、竞争性考试、编码、语言、音乐、健身、专业技能等。只需描述您想学习的内容，平台就会显示根据您的喜好量身定制的相关导师匹配。
plugin_asdk_app_6a22ca6ec2608191bc47a4bb.productIntroEn: UrbanPro Tutor Finder helps learners discover experienced tutors and coaching providers for academics, competitive exams, coding, languages, music, fitness, professional skills, and more. Simply describe what you want to learn, and the platform surfaces relevant tutor matches tailored to your preferences.
plugin_asdk_app_6a22ca6ec2608191bc47a4bb.longDescription:
UrbanPro Tutor Finder helps learners discover experienced tutors and coaching providers for academics, competitive exams, coding, languages, music, fitness, professional skills, and more. Simply describe what you want to learn, and the platform surfaces relevant tutor matches tailored to your preferences.

Whether you are looking for online classes, home tutors, or in-person coaching in your city, UrbanPro Tutor Finder makes it easy to explore options based on subject, budget, teaching mode, ratings, and experience.

What you can search for

• “Maths tutor for Class 10 CBSE in Bangalore”
• “Online IELTS coaching under ₹800/hour”
• “Home guitar teacher near me”


Key Features

• Search tutors using natural-language requests
• Discover both online and offline classes
• Explore tutors across 1,000+ learning categories
• Compare ratings, reviews, experience, and hourly fees
• Find tutors for school subjects, entrance exams, coding, languages, music, yoga, and more
• Access verified tutor profiles with direct links to continue on UrbanPro

Who it’s for

• Students preparing for exams like JEE, NEET, CAT, IELTS, UPSC, and more
• Parents searching for tutors for school students
• Working professionals learning coding, languages, or career skills
• Hobby learners exploring music, arts, dance, fitness, and personal interests

How it works

Enter what you want to learn in plain English
Receive tutor recommendations matched to your requirements
Open tutor profiles on UrbanPro to continue and connect directly

Notes

Tutor discovery happens within the app experience, while booking and further interactions take place on UrbanPro.
plugin_asdk_app_6a22ca6ec2608191bc47a4bb.longDescriptionZh:
UrbanPro Tutor Finder 可帮助学习者找到经验丰富的导师和辅导提供者，涉及学术、竞争性考试、编码、语言、音乐、健身、专业技能等。只需描述您想学习的内容，平台就会显示根据您的喜好量身定制的相关导师匹配。

无论您是在您的城市寻找在线课程、家庭导师还是现场辅导，UrbanPro Tutor Finder 都可以让您轻松根据主题、预算、教学模式、评分和经验探索选择。

您可以搜索什么

• “班加罗尔 CBSE 10 年级数学导师”
• “在线雅思考试辅导费用低于 800 卢比/小时”
•“我附近的家庭吉他老师”


主要特点

• 使用自然语言请求搜索导师
• 探索在线和离线课程
• 探索 1,000 多个学习类别的导师
• 比较评级、评论、体验和每小时费用
• 寻找学校科目、入学考试、编码、语言、音乐、瑜伽等导师
• 通过直接链接访问经过验证的导师个人资料，以继续使用 UrbanPro

为谁而设

• 准备 JEE、NEET、CAT、IELTS、UPSC 等考试的学生
• 家长为学校学生寻找家教
• 学习编码、语言或职业技能的职业人士
• 爱好学习者探索音乐、艺术、舞蹈、健身和个人兴趣

它是如何运作的

用简单的英语输入您想学习的内容
接收符合您要求的导师推荐
在 UrbanPro 上打开导师资料以继续并直接连接

注释

导师发现发生在应用程序体验中，而预订和进一步的互动则在 UrbanPro 上进行。

plugin_asdk_app_6a69bfa20cd88191acaf7d98.name: Maakrop
plugin_asdk_app_6a69bfa20cd88191acaf7d98.productIntro: Maakrop 是一款让日常课堂管理变得更简单、更方便的助教。教师可以在一个地方通过对话访问重要信息并处理常见任务，而无需花费时间浏览多个页面、搜索菜单或手动收集信息。
plugin_asdk_app_6a69bfa20cd88191acaf7d98.productIntroEn: Maakrop is a teaching assistant that makes everyday classroom management simpler and more convenient. Teachers can access important information and handle common tasks through conversation in one place, without spending time navigating multiple pages, searching through menus, or gathering information manually.
plugin_asdk_app_6a69bfa20cd88191acaf7d98.longDescription:
Maakrop is a teaching assistant that makes everyday classroom management simpler and more convenient. Teachers can access important information and handle common tasks through conversation in one place, without spending time navigating multiple pages, searching through menus, or gathering information manually.

Maakrop can help teachers review teaching schedules, find classes, subjects, and students, check and summarize attendance, review scores, track missing work, and quickly understand what is happening across their classes. It can also assist with tasks such as adding or updating student information, creating assessments, recording scores and attendance, and importing student rosters or teaching schedules.

For tasks involving several steps, Maakrop can gather the relevant information, prepare a clear plan, and present the details for review before any changes are saved. This helps reduce mistakes in repetitive administrative work while keeping teachers informed and in control.

Whether teachers are preparing for the day, checking absences, following up on missing assignments, reviewing class performance, or organizing classroom information, Maakrop reduces the time spent on administration and searching for data. This gives teachers more time to focus on lessons, planning, and supporting their students.
plugin_asdk_app_6a69bfa20cd88191acaf7d98.longDescriptionZh:
Maakrop 是一款让日常课堂管理变得更简单、更方便的助教。教师可以在一个地方通过对话访问重要信息并处理常见任务，而无需花费时间浏览多个页面、搜索菜单或手动收集信息。

Maakrop 可以帮助教师查看教学计划、查找班级、科目和学生、检查和总结出勤情况、查看分数、跟踪遗漏的作业，并快速了解班级中发生的情况。它还可以协助完成添加或更新学生信息、创建评估、记录分数和出勤以及导入学生名册或教学计划等任务。

对于涉及多个步骤的任务，Maakrop 可以收集相关信息，准备清晰的计划，并在保存任何更改之前提供详细信息以供审核。这有助于减少重复性行政工作中的错误，同时让教师了解情况并进行控制。

无论教师是在为一天做准备、检查缺勤情况、跟进遗漏的作业、查看课堂表现还是整理课堂信息，Maakrop 都可以减少管理和搜索数据所花费的时间。这让教师有更多时间专注于课程、计划和支持学生。
defaultPrompts: Overview of student attendance this semester.
Summary of Math scores.
defaultPromptsZh: 本学期学生出勤情况概览。
数学成绩摘要。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9c2787bc48819197698e71.name: Open Ephemeris
plugin_asdk_app_6a9c2787bc48819197698e71.productIntro: Open Ephemeris 为 ChatGPT 提供了真正的天文学工作。每个位置均来自 NASA JPL DE440 星历，覆盖 1550-2650 CE，精度为亚角秒，与航天器导航使用的内核相同，因此位置是计算出来的，而不是估计的。
plugin_asdk_app_6a9c2787bc48819197698e71.productIntroEn: Open Ephemeris gives ChatGPT real astronomy to work from. Every position comes from the NASA JPL DE440 ephemeris covering 1550-2650 CE at sub-arcsecond precision, the same kernel used for spacecraft navigation, so positions are computed rather than estimated.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9c2787bc48819197698e71.longDescription:
Open Ephemeris gives ChatGPT real astronomy to work from. Every position comes from the NASA JPL DE440 ephemeris covering 1550-2650 CE at sub-arcsecond precision, the same kernel used for spacecraft navigation, so positions are computed rather than estimated.

Ask for a natal chart and an interactive wheel opens in the conversation. Click a planet, a house, or an aspect line and the interpretation loads in place. Switch house systems without asking again. The same applies to Human Design bodygraphs, synastry bi-wheels, transit timelines, Vedic Rashi grids and BaZi Four Pillars charts.

Beyond charts: transits and progressions, solar and lunar returns, eclipse timing and local visibility, astrocartography, electional search for timing windows, and fixed-star positions.

Free to start, no card required.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9c2787bc48819197698e71.longDescriptionZh:
Open Ephemeris 为 ChatGPT 提供了真正的天文学工作。每个位置均来自 NASA JPL DE440 星历，覆盖 1550-2650 CE，精度为亚角秒，与航天器导航使用的内核相同，因此位置是计算出来的，而不是估计的。

索取本命盘，对话中就会打开一个互动轮盘。单击行星、房屋或相位线，解释就会加载到位。无需再次询问即可切换房屋系统。这同样适用于人体设计人体图、双轮图、行进时间线、吠陀拉希网格和八字四柱图。

除了图表之外：凌日和渐进、太阳和月球回归、日食计时和当地能见度、天文制图、时间窗口的选举搜索以及恒星位置。

免费开始，无需卡。

plugin_asdk_app_6a4f4f994e30819188b4a626.name: Agent Kunjani
plugin_asdk_app_6a4f4f994e30819188b4a626.productIntro: Kunjani 特工将培训简介转变为 Kunjani 上的即用型套牌，Kunjani 是一个基于 WhatsApp、人工智能驱动的游戏学习平台，用于培训一线和分布式团队。
plugin_asdk_app_6a4f4f994e30819188b4a626.productIntroEn: Agent Kunjani turns a training brief into a ready-to-play deck on Kunjani, a WhatsApp-based, AI-powered game-based learning platform used to train frontline and distributed teams.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4f4f994e30819188b4a626.longDescription:
Agent Kunjani turns a training brief into a ready-to-play deck on Kunjani, a WhatsApp-based, AI-powered game-based learning platform used to train frontline and distributed teams.

Describe who you are training and the behaviour you want to change, and Agent Kunjani designs the learning outcomes and writes the activities across Kunjani's six activity types (the Suits: Jolt, Advance, Mystery, Oops, Explain, Demonstrate), each with a built-in answer key and grading notes for Kunjani's AI grader. It then publishes the finished deck straight into your Kunjani account, where your learners play it on WhatsApp.

You stay in control: it proposes learning outcomes for your approval before writing activities, and you can list your existing decks, edit individual activities and outcomes, or update a deck in place. Connecting requires your own Kunjani account, and the app only ever reads and writes decks your account is authorized to access.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4f4f994e30819188b4a626.longDescriptionZh:
Kunjani 特工将培训简介转变为 Kunjani 上的即用型套牌，Kunjani 是一个基于 WhatsApp、人工智能驱动的游戏学习平台，用于培训一线和分布式团队。

描述您正在培训的对象以及您想要改变的行为，Kunjani 特工会设计学习成果并编写 Kunjani 六种活动类型（套装：摇动、前进、神秘、哎呀、解释、演示）的活动，每种活动都带有 Kunjani 人工智能评分器的内置答案和评分注释。然后，它会将完成的牌组直接发布到您的 Kunjani 帐户中，您的学习者可以在 WhatsApp 上玩它。

您始终掌控一切：它会在编写活动之前提出学习成果供您批准，并且您可以列出现有的套牌、编辑单个活动和结果，或者更新套牌。连接需要您自己的 Kunjani 帐户，并且该应用程序仅读取和写入您的帐户有权访问的牌组。

plugin_asdk_app_6a93020715548191b7d0ce88.name: Noteflix
plugin_asdk_app_6a93020715548191b7d0ce88.productIntro: Noteflix 帮助学习者将当前 ChatGPT 对话中提供的文本转变为活跃的学习工作流程。它可以组织忠实来源的指南，创建抽认卡和直接检索练习，引导一次一个问题的复习，并根据学习者的截止日期和可用时间制定切合实际的复习计划。
plugin_asdk_app_6a93020715548191b7d0ce88.productIntroEn: Noteflix helps learners turn text supplied in the current ChatGPT conversation into an active study workflow. It can organize source-faithful guides, create flashcards and direct-retrieval practice, lead one-question-at-a-time review, and build realistic review plans from the learner's deadline and available time.
plugin_asdk_app_6a93020715548191b7d0ce88.longDescription:
Noteflix helps learners turn text supplied in the current ChatGPT conversation into an active study workflow. It can organize source-faithful guides, create flashcards and direct-retrieval practice, lead one-question-at-a-time review, and build realistic review plans from the learner's deadline and available time.

The plugin does not inspect uploads, retrieve prior chats, query memory, or search existing Noteflix content. Source material for a study workflow must be supplied as text in the current request. It flags source conflicts instead of silently resolving them and treats instructions embedded inside supplied study material as quoted content rather than commands.

When a learner explicitly asks to save an artifact, the plugin shows the exact title, Markdown body, optional summary and key points, destination, and private visibility, then waits for separate confirmation. Only after an affirmative response does it call create_private_note. The tool can create one private record for the exact OAuth-connected Firebase UID. It cannot list, read, search, update, publish, share, or delete existing notes, and it cannot generate media.

Every save requires an existing eligible Noteflix account. Entitlement checks fail closed for the exact OAuth UID; the plugin never uses a service account's subscription or another user's access. It does not offer purchases, pricing, checkout, plan management, subscription restoration, or upgrade links inside ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a93020715548191b7d0ce88.longDescriptionZh:
Noteflix 帮助学习者将当前 ChatGPT 对话中提供的文本转变为活跃的学习工作流程。它可以组织忠实来源的指南，创建抽认卡和直接检索练习，引导一次一个问题的复习，并根据学习者的截止日期和可用时间制定切合实际的复习计划。

该插件不会检查上传内容、检索之前的聊天记录、查询内存或搜索现有的 Noteflix 内容。研究工作流程的源材料必须作为当前请求中的文本提供。它标记源冲突而不是默默地解决它们，并将嵌入在提供的学习材料中的指令视为引用的内容而不是命令。

当学习者明确要求保存工件时，该插件会显示确切的标题、Markdown 正文、可选摘要和要点、目的地和私有可见性，然后等待单独的确认。只有在得到肯定响应后，它才会调用 create_private_note。该工具可以为准确的 OAuth 连接 Firebase UID 创建一条私有记录。它无法列出、阅读、搜索、更新、发布、共享或删除现有笔记，也无法生成媒体。

每次保存都需要现有的合格 Noteflix 帐户。对于确切的 OAuth UID，权利检查失败关闭；该插件从不使用服务帐户的订阅或其他用户的访问权限。它不提供 ChatGPT 内的购买、定价、结账、计划管理、订阅恢复或升级链接。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa6b41727648191a996159d.productIntro: Vitark 将 ChatGPT 与印度判例法和立法联系起来，以进行基于源记录的研究。检索最高法院和高等法院的判决以及可用的法庭和监管机构的决定；按名称、案例编号、中性引文或 CNR 查找案例；检索可用的判断文本；并查找法律规定。
plugin_asdk_app_6aa6b41727648191a996159d.productIntroEn: Vitark connects ChatGPT to Indian case law and legislation for research grounded in source records. Search Supreme Court and High Court judgments and available tribunal and regulator decisions; find a case by name, case number, neutral citation or CNR; retrieve available judgment text; and look up statutory provisions.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa6b41727648191a996159d.longDescription:
Vitark connects ChatGPT to Indian case law and legislation for research grounded in source records. Search Supreme Court and High Court judgments and available tribunal and regulator decisions; find a case by name, case number, neutral citation or CNR; retrieve available judgment text; and look up statutory provisions.

Explore similar cases, entity-linked cases and available citation links. Results include available source identifiers and retrieval limits. Judgment text may arrive in slices, and citation links may be unresolved candidates rather than verified later treatment. Verify the underlying text before relying on a result.

Connect your existing Vitark account through secure sign-in. Successful substantive research calls use its credit balance; checking the balance is free. Vitark provides legal research information and does not replace advice from a qualified advocate.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa6b41727648191a996159d.longDescriptionZh:
Vitark 将 ChatGPT 与印度判例法和立法联系起来，以进行基于源记录的研究。检索最高法院和高等法院的判决以及可用的法庭和监管机构的决定；按名称、案例编号、中性引文或 CNR 查找案例；检索可用的判断文本；并查找法律规定。

探索类似案例、实体相关案例和可用的引用链接。结果包括可用的源标识符和检索限制。判断文本可能会分段到达，引用链接可能是未解决的候选者，而不是经过验证的后续处理。在依赖结果之前验证底层文本。

通过安全登录连接您现有的 Vitark 帐户。成功的实质性研究电话使用其信用余额；检查余额是免费的。 Vitark 提供法律研究信息，但不能取代合格律师的建议。

Even rough drafts are polished smoothly, the “Blossom Editor” helps you write in any language with ease.
Hundreds of thousands of foreign-language journal entries are updated daily on Blossom.

Blossom is the world’s first and largest AI language-learning platform that integrates journaling with AI, allowing daily diary writing to naturally turn into language learning.
With just one sentence a day, you can build a habit that covers all core language skills — writing, speaking, listening, and reading.

With a single global journal written together with AI each day, you get vocabulary study, shadowing, AI tutor conversations, and more. Every language learning feature made possible through journaling.

Join global Blossom users and record and share your daily life in a foreign language.

✨ AI Tools

🌍 Global Community

• Language Exchange: Chat with global users in real-time and make foreign friends naturally.
• Blossom Points: Earn points through community activities and exchange them for real cash.

🌐 Learning Languages
English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, Malay, Khmer, Burmese, Turkish, Kazakh, Russian, Ukrainian, Mongolian, Spanish, Portuguese, Hindi, Arabic, French, German, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Greek, Romanian, Hungarian, Czech, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, Bulgarian, Croatian, Slovak, Slovenian, Lithuanian, Latvian, Estonian, Icelandic, Irish, Maltese, Luxembourgish, Serbian, Catalan, Albanian, Belarusian, Bosnian, Galician, Macedonian, Basque

plugin_asdk_app_6a8f5480712881918e27a32c.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT or Codex to a curated, read-only ClassWise academic overview using an active school or district staff-member or administrator account. ClassWise can identify authorized organizations, list permitted district descendants, show academic terms and course-catalog entries, list classes with bounded basic day/time/room meetings, show class subjects, and return subject and bell-period schedule details only when the current role has schedule-management or gradebook permission. It returns one school-wide active-enrollment count per school, with counts below 10 suppressed. A school user remains limited to current active staff-member or administrator access for that school. A district user retains only the descendant-school scope already granted by an eligible ClassWise role. ClassWise rechecks current eligibility and permissions for every organization-specific request. The public connector cannot change ClassWise data and does not expose student-level records, per-class enrollment counts, enrollment cells by program, grade, or status, grades, attendance, health or medical information, disability or accommodation records, individual-service plans, discipline records, government-issued identifiers, finance or payment records, message content, credentials, authentication or role administration, raw SQL, arbitrary URLs, or platform controls. Separately contracted private administrator integrations are outside this listing.

plugin_asdk_app_6a0e3d02f6e481918ad0f8c5.productIntro: SuperQDA 将您的定性研究工作区连接到 ChatGPT。直接在对话中访问您的研究项目、文档、代码和分析。
plugin_asdk_app_6a0e3d02f6e481918ad0f8c5.productIntroEn: SuperQDA connects your qualitative research workspace to ChatGPT. Access your research projects, documents, codes, and analyses directly in conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a0e3d02f6e481918ad0f8c5.longDescription:
SuperQDA connects your qualitative research workspace to ChatGPT. Access your research projects, documents, codes, and analyses directly in conversation.

What you can do:
- Browse and read all your uploaded documents (PDFs, Word files, transcripts)
- Perform semantic search across your research data using perform_semantic_search
- Create and apply qualitative codes to text segments using create_code and create_coded_segment
- Write analytical memos and save structured analyses
- Search for keywords across all project documents with perform_text_search

SuperQDA is a qualitative data analysis (QDA) platform used by researchers, academics, and students for thematic analysis, grounded theory, and other qualitative methodologies. This integration lets you leverage ChatGPT's reasoning capabilities directly on your research data without leaving the conversation.

All data access is secured with OAuth 2.0 + PKCE. Your credentials are never shared with ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a0e3d02f6e481918ad0f8c5.longDescriptionZh:
SuperQDA 将您的定性研究工作区连接到 ChatGPT。直接在对话中访问您的研究项目、文档、代码和分析。

你可以做什么：
- 浏览并阅读您上传的所有文档（PDF、Word 文件、成绩单）
- 使用 Perform_semantic_search 对您的研究数据执行语义搜索
- 使用 create_code 和 create_coded_segment 创建定性代码并将其应用于文本段
- 编写分析备忘录并保存结构化分析
- 使用perform_text_search在所有项目文档中搜索关键字

SuperQDA 是一个定性数据分析 (QDA) 平台，供研究人员、学者和学生使用，用于主题分析、扎根理论和其他定性方法。通过这种集成，您可以直接在研究数据上利用 ChatGPT 的推理功能，而无需离开对话。

所有数据访问均通过 OAuth 2.0 + PKCE 进行保护。您的凭据绝不会与 ChatGPT 共享。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9bec31c93c8191a6e995f2.name: Clairwave
plugin_asdk_app_6a9bec31c93c8191a6e995f2.productIntro: Clairwave 给出 ChatGPT 扎根的海洋声学答案，而不是根据记忆进行估计。询问世界海洋中的任何一点，该插件都会在 Clairwave 平台上运行传播物理学：沿方位的抛物线方程传输损耗、声纳方程检测范围和完整的 3D Bellhop 传输损耗体积，由 Clairwave 提供的测深、季节性声速剖面和海底声学参数驱动。
plugin_asdk_app_6a9bec31c93c8191a6e995f2.productIntroEn: Clairwave gives ChatGPT grounded ocean-acoustics answers instead of estimates from memory. Ask about any point in the world ocean and the plugin runs propagation physics on Clairwave's platform: parabolic-equation transmission loss along a bearing, sonar-equation detection ranges, and full 3D Bellhop transmission-loss volumes, driven by Clairwave-served bathymetry, seasonal sound-speed p…
plugin_asdk_app_6a9bec31c93c8191a6e995f2.longDescription:
Clairwave gives ChatGPT grounded ocean-acoustics answers instead of estimates from memory. Ask about any point in the world ocean and the plugin runs propagation physics on Clairwave's platform: parabolic-equation transmission loss along a bearing, sonar-equation detection ranges, and full 3D Bellhop transmission-loss volumes, driven by Clairwave-served bathymetry, seasonal sound-speed profiles and seabed acoustic parameters.

It also covers ships: search live AIS positions by name or MMSI, list vessels near a point, estimate a vessel's radiated-noise source level from its class, speed and dimensions, fetch a photo, open an MMSI-keyed 3D hull model from the open shipshape fleet, and compute the power-summed noise level at a fixed site such as a fish farm or hydrophone.

Every location accepts a place name ("outside Halifax", "Strait of Hormuz") as well as coordinates. Every simulation result carries a replication bundle (sound-speed profile, bottom parameters, bathymetry transect, grid) and a run id whose files are downloadable, plus a link that opens the run visualized in the Clairwave web platform with no sign-in.

Typical uses: sonar and hydrophone planning, marine-mammal noise exposure screening, aquaculture noise monitoring, teaching ocean acoustics, checking a ship's audibility at a receiver, and exploring how season and seabed change propagation. No account is required. Compute calls share a platform-wide budget of about 20 per minute. Results are climatology-based and are not a substitute for in-situ measurements.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9bec31c93c8191a6e995f2.longDescriptionZh:
Clairwave 给出 ChatGPT 扎根的海洋声学答案，而不是根据记忆进行估计。询问世界海洋中的任何一点，该插件都会在 Clairwave 平台上运行传播物理学：沿方位的抛物线方程传输损耗、声纳方程检测范围和完整的 3D Bellhop 传输损耗体积，由 Clairwave 提供的测深、季节性声速剖面和海底声学参数驱动。

它还涵盖船舶：按名称或 MMSI 搜索实时 AIS 位置，列出某个点附近的船舶，根据船舶的类别、速度和尺寸估计船舶的辐射噪声源水平，获取照片，从开放船型船队中打开 MMSI 键控的 3D 船体模型，并计算固定地点（例如养鱼场或水听器）的功率总和噪声水平。

每个位置都接受地名（“哈利法克斯之外”、“霍尔木兹海峡”）以及坐标。每个模拟结果都带有一个复制包（声速剖面、底部参数、测深断面、网格）和一个可下载文件的运行 ID，以及一个无需登录即可在 Clairwave Web 平台中打开可视化运行的链接。

典型用途：声纳和水听器规划、海洋哺乳动物噪声暴露筛查、水产养殖噪声监测、海洋声学教学、在接收器上检查船舶的可听度以及探索季节和海底变化如何传播。无需帐户。计算调用共享大约每分钟 20 个平台范围的预算。结果基于气候学，不能替代现场测量。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9fdc37ec5c819186e2d668.name: RubricMark Practice
plugin_asdk_app_6a9fdc37ec5c819186e2d668.productIntro: 在 ChatGPT 中请求练习测试或抽认卡。
plugin_asdk_app_6a9fdc37ec5c819186e2d668.productIntroEn: Ask for a practice test or flashcards in ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9fdc37ec5c819186e2d668.longDescription:
Ask for a practice test or flashcards in ChatGPT.

For a named exam (HAST, Selective, IELTS, JLPT, GAMSAT, and others), you get three sample questions in the chat and in a RubricMark widget. Answer with A, B, C or D. You then see a sample mark — each verdict and a short explanation — plus a link to create a RubricMark account for the timed sit and the full criterion report.

Paste a writing draft for a short sample comment. This is not a band score. Create an account for the quoted report.

Ask for flashcards on a topic or exam. ChatGPT writes retrieve-first cards in this chat. RubricMark shows one card at a time. Tap to check, then create an account to save the deck.

Plans and checkout stay on RubricMark. Nothing is sold in ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9fdc37ec5c819186e2d668.longDescriptionZh:
在 ChatGPT 中请求练习测试或抽认卡。

对于指定考试（HAST、选择性考试、雅思、JLPT、GAMSAT 等），您可以在聊天和 RubricMark 小部件中获得三个示例问题。回答 A、B、C 或 D。然后，您会看到一个样本标记（每个结论和一个简短的解释）以及一个链接，用于为定时考试和完整的标准报告创建 RubricMark 帐户。

粘贴简短示例评论的草稿。这不是乐队总谱。为引用的报告创建一个帐户。

索要有关某个主题或考试的抽认卡。 ChatGPT 在此聊天中写入检索优先卡。 RubricMark 一次显示一张卡片。点击进行检查，然后创建一个帐户来保存该牌组。

计划和结帐保留在 RubricMark 上。 ChatGPT 中不出售任何东西。

Give me a LNAT practice test.
Make flashcards for JLPT N5 verbs.

plugin_asdk_app_6a55555b70508191b3453ca8.productIntroEn: Padlet is a visual board platform used by teachers, students, and teams to collect, organize, and share content on collaborative boards called padlets. The Padlet app for ChatGPT connects the user's own Padlet account via OAuth so they can work with their padlets directly in conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a55555b70508191b3453ca8.longDescription:
Padlet is a visual board platform used by teachers, students, and teams to collect, organize, and share content on collaborative boards called padlets. The Padlet app for ChatGPT connects the user's own Padlet account via OAuth so they can work with their padlets directly in conversation.

With this app, users can:
- Create padlets and organize them with sections, layouts, wallpapers, and appearance settings.
- Add, edit, arrange, pin, and sort posts, and draw connections between posts on Freeform boards.
- Read, search, and summarize board content, including AI analysis of images, videos, audio, and document attachments.
- Comment on posts and moderate discussion.
- Manage sharing settings by modifying permissions, passwords, collaborators, and email invitations.
- Schedule automations such as timed freezes, and freeze or unfreeze boards on demand.
- Grade student submissions and sync grades to a connected LMS (e.g. Canvas or Schoology) via LTI.
- For school and team library admins: manage membership and invitations, per-role permissions, SSO configuration (OAuth providers and SAML), approved email domains, content safety, and allowed attachment types.

The app does not yet fully support Padlet's Sandbox (whiteboard) format; it works with Padlet's other board formats.

All actions run against the authenticated user's Padlet account and respect Padlet's permission model — the app can only see and change what the signed-in user could see and change in Padlet itself. Deletions of posts and sections are soft-deletes that can be restored with a dedicated restore tool, and the small number of irreversible operations (deleting comments, automations, or custom fields, removing collaborators, invitations, or approved domains) are annotated as destructive so the assistant confirms with the user before proceeding.
plugin_asdk_app_6a55555b70508191b3453ca8.longDescriptionZh:
Padlet 是一个可视板平台，供教师、学生和团队用来在称为 padlet 的协作板上收集、组织和共享内容。 ChatGPT 的 Padlet 应用程序通过 OAuth 连接用户自己的 Padlet 帐户，以便他们可以直接在对话中使用其 padlet。

通过此应用程序，用户可以：
- 创建小板并通过部分、布局、壁纸和外观设置来组织它们。
- 添加、编辑、排列、固定和排序帖子，并在自由格式板上的帖子之间建立联系。
- 阅读、搜索和总结看板内容，包括图像、视频、音频和文档附件的 AI 分析。
- 对帖子进行评论并进行适度的讨论。
- 通过修改权限、密码、协作者和电子邮件邀请来管理共享设置。
- 安排自动化，例如定时冻结以及按需冻结或解冻板。
- 对学生提交的成绩进行评分，并通过 LTI 将成绩同步到连接的 LMS（例如 Canvas 或 Schoology）。
- 对于学校和团队图书馆管理员：管理会员资格和邀请、每个角色权限、SSO 配置（OAuth 提供商和 SAML）、批准的电子邮件域、内容安全和允许的附件类型。

该应用程序尚未完全支持Padlet的Sandbox（白板）格式；它可以与 Padlet 的其他板格式配合使用。

所有操作都针对经过身份验证的用户的 Padlet 帐户运行，并尊重 Padlet 的权限模型 - 应用程序只能查看和更改登录用户可以在 Padlet 本身中查看和更改的内容。帖子和章节的删除是软删除，可以使用专用的恢复工具进行恢复，并且少量不可逆的操作（删除评论、自动化或自定义字段、删除协作者、邀请或批准的域）被注释为破坏性的，因此助手在继续之前与用户确认。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa2bcbd58c08191b12c0139.name: VoteMapper
plugin_asdk_app_6aa2bcbd58c08191b12c0139.description: 绘制选举图并计算席位
plugin_asdk_app_6aa2bcbd58c08191b12c0139.productIntro: 询问美国大选——即将到来的 2026 年中期选举，或 1788 年以来的任何一次总统选举——并得到带有日期的答案。
plugin_asdk_app_6aa2bcbd58c08191b12c0139.productIntroEn: Ask about a US election — the 2026 midterms ahead, or any presidential election since 1788 — and get an answer with a date on it.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa2bcbd58c08191b12c0139.longDescription:
Ask about a US election — the 2026 midterms ahead, or any presidential election since 1788 — and get an answer with a date on it.

For 2026: the consensus competitiveness rating for any of the 100 Senate seats and 435 House districts, a consensus of Cook Political Report and Sabato's Crystal Ball, along with which races are genuinely in play and what forecasters have changed their minds about since the last update.

The part a chat assistant cannot do on its own is the arithmetic. Describe a scenario in plain language — "Republicans hold every toss-up but lose Maine" — and VoteMapper resolves it against the ratings in effect and returns a full chamber map you can argue with. Click any race to reassign it and the tally follows. The Senate has 65 seats that are not on the 2026 ballot and are already counted; getting that right is the difference between a real answer and a confident wrong one.

For history: every presidential election from 1788 to 2024, as a map rather than a paragraph. Compare two elections and see which states changed hands, trace one state's whole voting history and current streak, or reassign states to ask what a different outcome would have meant. Multi-way elections like 1860 and 1912 come back whole rather than flattened into two parties.

You can also check a sealed VoteMapper forecast. A prediction declared in the app is verified here by fingerprint and scored against published race calls once results land — over called races only, so an uncalled race is never counted as a miss.

VoteMapper is a simulator. It reports no live vote counts, returns or called races, and its historical data holds electoral votes, not popular-vote totals. Every answer carries the date its data was published, both parties are treated symmetrically throughout, and the connector takes no position on any race.

Read-only and stateless: no account, no sign-in, nothing written, nothing retained between requests.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa2bcbd58c08191b12c0139.longDescriptionZh:
询问美国大选——即将到来的 2026 年中期选举，或 1788 年以来的任何一次总统选举——并得到带有日期的答案。

2026 年：100 个参议院席位和 435 个众议院选区的共识竞争力评级、库克政治报告和萨巴托水晶球的共识，以及哪些竞选真正在进行，以及自上次更新以来预测者改变了想法。

聊天助手无法独立完成的部分是算术。用通俗易懂的语言描述一个场景——“共和党赢得了所有的胜利，但输掉了缅因州”——VoteMapper 会根据实际的收视率来解决这个问题，并返回一个完整的房间地图，你可以争论。单击任何比赛以重新分配它，然后统计结果。参议院有 65 个席位未列入 2026 年投票但已计票；正确答案是真正答案和自信错误答案之间的区别。

对于历史：从 1788 年到 2024 年的每一次总统选举，都是一张地图而不是一段文字。比较两次选举，看看哪些州易手，追踪一个州的整个投票历史和当前的投票记录，或者重新分配州以询问不同的结果意味着什么。像 1860 年和 1912 年这样的多选选举都是整体回归的，而不是扁平化为两党。

您还可以检查密封的 VoteMapper 预测。应用程序中宣布的预测将通过指纹进行验证，并在结果公布后根据已发布的比赛呼叫进行评分 - 仅针对已呼叫的比赛，因此未呼叫的比赛永远不会被视为错过。

VoteMapper 是一个模拟器。它不报告实时计票、投票结果或选举结果，其历史数据包含选举人票，而不是普选票总数。每个答案都带有其数据发布的日期，双方在整个过程中都得到对称对待，并且连接器在任何比赛中都不采取任何立场。

只读和无状态：没有帐户，没有登录，没有写入任何内容，请求之间没有保留任何内容。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9e3034e4e48191b7588522.productIntroEn: Connect your Read Frog learning workspace to find saved vocabulary and reading notes, organize notebases, manage flashcard templates, and understand your study progress.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9e3034e4e48191b7588522.longDescription:
Connect your Read Frog learning workspace to find saved vocabulary and reading notes, organize notebases, manage flashcard templates, and understand your study progress.

Search notes by text, inspect notebase fields, save new learning material, and update existing notes. View generated flashcards, review history, and study statistics. When you request changes and grant the relevant permissions, Read Frog can also record reviews and update study settings.

Requires a Read Frog account with existing Ultra access. You choose which account, notebase, note, template, and study permissions to grant during authorization. The integration can read and write your data according to those permissions. Deleting notes, fields, templates, or notebases can remove related learning content.

plugin_asdk_app_6a90b5d7def08191a3088f81.name: Flash
plugin_asdk_app_6a90b5d7def08191a3088f81.productIntro: Flash 是一款间隔重复抽认卡应用程序，ChatGPT 可以为您运行。告诉 ChatGPT 您正在学习什么 - 粘贴章节、讲义、词汇列表，或者只是描述主题 - 它会将卡片写入您的 Flash 帐户中的卡片组中。当您想学习时，请这样说：ChatGPT 会询问每张应有的卡片，检查您输入的或用麦克风口述的答案，然后再次对它进行评分：困难、良好或简单。分级对数字、剂量、范围、单位和名称非常严格，这使得它非常适合护理、医学、法律、语言和其他“足够接近”的领域。
plugin_asdk_app_6a90b5d7def08191a3088f81.productIntroEn: Flash is a spaced-repetition flashcard app that ChatGPT can run for you. Tell ChatGPT what you're learning — paste a chapter, lecture notes, a vocabulary list, or just describe the topic — and it writes the cards into a deck in your Flash account.
plugin_asdk_app_6a90b5d7def08191a3088f81.longDescription:
Flash is a spaced-repetition flashcard app that ChatGPT can run for you. Tell ChatGPT what you're learning — paste a chapter, lecture notes, a vocabulary list, or just describe the topic — and it writes the cards into a deck in your Flash account. When you want to study, say so: ChatGPT asks each due card, checks your answer — typed, or dictated with the mic — and grades it Again, Hard, Good, or Easy. Grading is strict on numbers, doses, ranges, units, and names, which makes it a good fit for nursing, medicine, law, languages, and anything else where "close enough" isn't.

Every review is scheduled by FSRS, the modern spaced-repetition algorithm that models your memory and shows you each card right before you'd forget it. There are no settings to learn.

Nothing you drill with ChatGPT scrolls away: cards, answers, and review dates live in your Flash account, synced across devices, and you can also study on the web at flashmemorize.com. Existing Anki decks import whole (.apkg with cloze, hints, images, audio, LaTeX, typed answers, and nested decks), and everything exports back to Anki or CSV at any time.

What ChatGPT can do once connected: list your decks and due counts, create decks and cards, start and run a study session, reveal answers, submit grades, edit or delete cards, and adjust daily new-card limits.

A free Flash account is all you need. Flash has no ads, no tracking, and no third-party analytics.
plugin_asdk_app_6a90b5d7def08191a3088f81.longDescriptionZh:
Flash 是一款间隔重复抽认卡应用程序，ChatGPT 可以为您运行。告诉 ChatGPT 您正在学习什么 - 粘贴章节、讲义、词汇列表，或者只是描述主题 - 它会将卡片写入您的 Flash 帐户中的卡片组中。当您想学习时，请这样说：ChatGPT 会询问每张应有的卡片，检查您输入的或用麦克风口述的答案，然后再次对它进行评分：困难、良好或简单。分级对数字、剂量、范围、单位和名称非常严格，这使得它非常适合护理、医学、法律、语言和其他“足够接近”的领域。

每次复习都是由 FSRS 安排的，FSRS 是一种现代的间隔重复算法，可以模拟您的记忆并在您忘记之前向您展示每张卡片。没有可学习的设置。

您使用 ChatGPT 钻取的任何内容都不会滚动：卡片、答案和复习日期实时保存在您的 Flash 帐户中，跨设备同步，您还可以在 flashmemorize.com 上进行网络学习。现有的 Anki 甲板导入整个（.apkg 与完型填空、提示、图像、音频、LaTeX、键入的答案和嵌套甲板），并且所有内容都可以随时导出回 Anki 或 CSV。

连接后 ChatGPT 可以执行的操作：列出您的牌组和到期计数、创建牌组和卡片、启动和运行学习课程、显示答案、提交成绩、编辑或删除卡片以及调整每日新卡限制。

您只需要一个免费的 Flash 帐户即可。 Flash 没有广告、没有跟踪、也没有第三方分析。

What do I have due today?

plugin_asdk_app_6aa049955f488191aea7a652.productIntro: Gordito 是一个生活在 ChatGPT 中的个人语言学习伴侣。将任何对话中的单词和短语直接保存到笔记本中，然后让内置的间隔重复调度程序 (FSRS) 准确决定每个单词何时需要复习。到了练习的时候，戈迪托会根据应交的单词构建一个测验，诚实地对你的答案进行评分，并用你正在学习的语言写下每一个更正，这样阅读反馈本身就是练习。您的进度在设备之间同步：在笔记本电脑上开始测验并在手机上完成。 Gordito 涵盖了语言学习者的词汇积累和间隔重复测验。
plugin_asdk_app_6aa049955f488191aea7a652.productIntroEn: Gordito is a personal language-learning companion that lives inside ChatGPT. Save words and phrases from any conversation directly to your notebook, then let the built-in spaced-repetition scheduler (FSRS) decide exactly when each word needs reviewing.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa049955f488191aea7a652.longDescription: Gordito is a personal language-learning companion that lives inside ChatGPT. Save words and phrases from any conversation directly to your notebook, then let the built-in spaced-repetition scheduler (FSRS) decide exactly when each word needs reviewing. When it is time to practice, Gordito builds a quiz from the words that are due, grades your answers honestly, and writes every correction in the language you are learning so that reading the feedback is itself practice. Your progress syncs across devices: start a quiz on your laptop and finish it on your phone. Gordito covers vocabulary building and spaced-repetition quizzing for language learners. It does not cover grammar courses, pronunciation coaching, live tutoring, translation services, travel booking, or general reference lookup.

plugin_asdk_app_69abefb403248191a8f9a6a8.longDescription:
상식이는 60만개 퀴즈를 가지고 있는 한국어 상식 퀴즈 플랫폼입니다. 

ChatGPT에서 세 가지 퀴즈를 즐길 수 있습니다.

📖 독서퀴즈 — 1.2만권의 도서를 검색하고 책 내용 기반 OX/객관식 문제 5개를 풀어보세요.
🧠 일반상식 퀴즈 — 한국사, 과학, 생활상식, 사자성어, 국기, 동물, 영화 등 다양한 카테고리 문제.
🎒 초등 교과서 퀴즈 — 1~6학년 국어·수학·사회·과학·영어 교과서 기반 문제.

각 문제는 즉시 채점되며 해설까지 제공됩니다.
plugin_asdk_app_69abefb403248191a8f9a6a8.longDescriptionZh:
Common Sense 是一个韩国常识问答平台，拥有 600,000 个测验。 

您可以在 ChatGPT 上享受三个测验。

📖 阅读测验 — 搜索 12,000 本书，并根据书籍内容解决 5 道 OX/多项选择题。
🧠常识问答——韩国历史、科学、常识、成语、国旗、动物、电影等各种类别的问题。
🎒 小学教科书测验 — 基于 1 至 6 年级韩语、数学、社会研究、科学和英语教科书的问题。

每个问题都会立即评分并包含评论。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa412f3672081918227d4d9.productIntro: Sauna Monthly：桑拿房评价和计算器。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa412f3672081918227d4d9.longDescription: Sauna Monthly is an independent editorial site on saunas, heaters, cold plunges and recovery gear. This plugin lets ChatGPT search its catalogue of 83 products with real specifications, US prices and where to buy; read the site's reviews and editorial ratings; compare two to four products side by side; size a sauna heater from room dimensions; estimate what a sauna costs to run from heater power, session length and your electricity rate; and read any of its 32 articles, from brand reviews to the research behind heat and cold. Every answer links to the page it came from on saunamonthly.com. No account is needed and nothing about you or the conversation is stored.
